channels.name: primary-control
channels.notes: Discover and verify the project's actual primary control path.

channels.name: independent-recovery
channels.notes: Implement independently; do not copy another project's host/IP/path values.

continuity.next_step: Bind live host/path/repository state and runtime-certify recovery.

invariants: At least two independent recovery channels where technically possible.
Recovery-critical state must not depend on a known-degraded disk/path.
After interrupted chat/tool streams, reconcile live state before retrying.
Never store secrets/durable sessions/private keys in GitHub recovery documentation.
